T: What goes around comes around. So does dessert.
D: A smooth ad executive meets his match when his new boss treats him the way he treats women.
P: Serve the mains when Marcus and his friends sit down to Thanksgiving dinner.
S: a perfume launch only Strangé could throw

Little glazed meatballs on sticks in a sticky sweet chilli and grape jelly sauce. Mix 500g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs and salt, roll into 30 balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.
Soft tortillas spread with dill cream cheese, rolled with smoked salmon and cut into neat pinwheels.
Corn chips layered with beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, salsa and sour cream.
M: the friends' Thanksgiving at Marcus's place
Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested, with cornbread stuffing, candied yams, cranberry sauce and gravy.
Eye fillet seasoned and seared hard in butter, roasted at 200C to 54C, rested, the pan deglazed with red wine and stock for a glossy sauce, with a potato gratin and charred asparagus.
W: Roasted sweet potato mashed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes, whipped cream on top.
K: Gin, lemon and sugar topped with cold sparkling wine in a flute, with a lemon twist.

s.note: a perfume launch only Strangé could throw
s.how: Mix 500g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs and salt, roll into 30 balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer 250ml sweet chilli sauce with 150g grape jelly until glossy, add the meatballs and coat. Serve on toothpicks.
Mix 250g cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest and spread over 4 large tortillas. Lay 200g smoked salmon over, roll up tightly, wrap and chill 1 hour, then slice into 2cm pinwheels.

m.how: Layer thinly sliced potatoes with cream and bake at 180C for an hour. Sear 4 eye fillet steaks hard in butter, then roast at 200C to 54C and rest. Deglaze the pan with red wine and stock and reduce until glossy. Serve with charred asparagus.

w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, then mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla. Pour into a blind-baked sweet shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool and top with whipped cream.

d.how: Shake 30ml gin, 15ml lemon juice and 10ml sugar syrup with ice and strain into 4 flutes. Top each with 90ml cold sparkling wine and add a lemon twist.
